description: Patterns that have failed empirically. Title violations should warn (hard) or flag as experimental (soft). Severity dictates what happens at decision time.

patterns.name: Q-hook as title lead
patterns.description: Title starts with a question hook
examples_failed: Brain Fog? | Think Clearly with Sarangi (10.4% AVD, 76 views)
Overthinking? Trust Your Gut (2.4% AVD, 29 views)
Can't Focus? | 10 Min Deep Work (1.95% CTR, 40 views)
patterns.exception: Q-hook THUMBNAILS work in anxiety/overthinking lane only

patterns.name: Practice/utility lead in morning slot
patterns.description: Title leads with practice-named word in morning slot
patterns.evidence: Test 14: Morning Energy beat Breathing Exercise 59/41 (17.2pp)
examples_failed: Breathing Exercise Music | Dilruba Raga Yaman (lost 41/59)
Deep Work Music for Strategic Thinking (91 chars, 8.59% AVD)

patterns.name: Anxiety/stress family as title lead paired with Sitar
patterns.description: Anxiety_stress lead works only with Dilruba/Veena. Sitar+anxiety fails.
examples_failed: Anxiety Relief Music | Sitar & Alpha Waves (8.6% AVD, 41 views)
Mind at Rest | Sitar & Alpha Waves | Anxiety Relief Music (12.1% AVD)

patterns.name: Anxiety_stress family as title lead
patterns.description: Anxiety/stress vocabulary as lead has worst CTR (3.12%) and AVD (14.4%) on channel
patterns.evidence: Family avg CTR 3.12% / AVD 14.4% — worst on channel
patterns.alternative: Wrap anxiety intent in healing/calm vocabulary: 'Meditation Music for Anxiety'

patterns.name: Title length exceeds 65 chars
patterns.evidence: CTR drops to 2.93%, AVD to 15.5% for >75 char titles. Optimal 46-55 = 4.33% CTR.

patterns.name: Title length under 45 chars
patterns.description: Too short — only 1 ship in this band (high AVD but unproven at scale)
patterns.evidence: n=1 in this band; needs more data

patterns.name: 5+ slot stuffed title
patterns.description: Over-stuffing reduces both CTR and AVD

patterns.name: Sanskrit/raga name as title lead
patterns.description: Raga names as lead keyword empirically lose to SEO descriptor
patterns.evidence: Pattern observed but not isolated test. Pending Thu Santoor jargon-test.

patterns.name: Clinical-curiosity lead outside stress/burnout lane
patterns.description: Clinical leads (Dopamine/Cortisol/Brain Fog/Vagus Nerve Reset) only win in stress/burnout sub-lane
patterns.evidence: Brain Fog Sitar 110v/10.4% AVD; Jet Lag Recovery 26v/6% AVD

patterns.name: Distinctive phrase used within 20 days
patterns.description: Channel-looks-templated risk. Use phrase_locks.json to check.
patterns.evidence: 14 of 20 historical reuse incidents would have been blocked

patterns.name: Long poetic phrase as lead
patterns.description: Poetic/literary phrases lose to SEO descriptors
patterns.evidence: 'Go Back In Time' lost to Nostalgia Music

patterns.name: Hashtag-heavy title
patterns.description: Hashtag stacking in title weakens performance
patterns.evidence: Short-form ships with hashtag titles got low engagement

patterns.name: Emoji in title
patterns.description: Emoji in title correlates with low AVD

patterns.name: Schumann Resonance / specific Hz jargon as middle slot
patterns.description: 7.83Hz, Schumann, deep technical jargon as middle slot weakens calm/healing titles
patterns.evidence: Veena & 7.83Hz Schumann Resonance lost to Calm Your Mind 68/32

patterns.name: 'Soothing Music' as title lead
patterns.description: 'Soothing Music' lead has failed 2 consecutive ships in W2 (May 9 Peaceful Veena + May 16 Tired Mind Veena, both <2.5K views and <18% AVD)
patterns.evidence: May 9 Peaceful Music | Soothing Music with Veena = 2,409 views; May 12/16 Soothing Music | Veena for Tired Mind = 583 views
patterns.alternative: Use clinical-curiosity (Cortisol Reset / Vagus / Brain Fog) or specific-state self-recognition (Tired Mind / Mental Overload / Burnt Out) instead

patterns.name: Generic soft framings as title lead (post-W2 crash)
patterns.description: Generic non-specific calm/healing/meditation framings died in W2 crash. Audience needs SPECIFIC clinical-state hook OR specific-lifestyle hook to click + stay.
patterns.evidence: W2 crash analysis 2026-05-17: all generic-soft framings (Soothing/Sound Healing/Meditation Music/abstract Healing) underperformed at <1.5K views with <22% AVD. Cortisol Reset (clinical) was only W2 survivor at 7K.
patterns.alternative: Replace with clinical-curiosity (Cortisol/Vagus/Dopamine/Brain Fog/Mind Reset) or specific-state (Tired Mind/Burnt Out/Overstimulated/Stuck Emotions)

patterns.name: 'Music' suffix on state-based leads (suppresses VidIQ ~2x)
patterns.description: State-of-mind phrases score WAY higher without 'Music' suffix because native search captures both music + non-music seekers. Adding 'Music' narrows to niche music-search slice.
patterns.evidence: Mental Break Music = 28 → Mental Break = 57 (2.0x lift). Emotional Detox Music = 26 → Emotional Detox = 58 (2.2x). Banked 2026-05-17.
patterns.exception: KEEP 'Music' suffix for SEO-cluster leads where it's the dominant search form: Healing Music, Sleep Music, Brain Reset Music, Stress Relief Music, Comfort Music. These are music-search clusters first.
patterns.rule: For state-of-mind lead → drop 'Music'. Let instrument slot 2 carry the music signal.
